title: Ordinal number cards and timetable frame
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 14 (Ordinal number cards and timetable frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 14: Bridge: first, second, third: ordinal numbers and greetings. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Using ordinals
points: أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الثَّامِنِ: I am in Year 8
رَمَضَانُ الشَّهْرُ التَّاسِعُ: Ramadan is the ninth month

cards:
أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا
ahlan wa sahlan
welcome
blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.

parts.text: أَنَا فِي (I am in). الصَّفِّ (the class/year, with kasrah after فِي). Eighth, masculine: الثَّامِنِ.

questions.q: Reply to أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (to a boy).
Core: Write your school day in order: الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى ...، الحِصَّةُ الثَّانِيَةُ ... (four lessons; subjects may be in English).
questions.a: For example: الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى: الرِّيَاضِيَّات. الحِصَّةُ الثَّانِيَةُ: العَرَبِيَّة. الحِصَّةُ الثَّالِثَةُ: العُلُوم. الحِصَّةُ الرَّابِعَةُ: القُرْآن.

questions.q: Extend: Write a four-line welcome dialogue with أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا, تَشَرَّفْنَا and your year group.
questions.a: For example: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا. أَهْلًا بِكَ. أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الثَّامِنِ. تَشَرَّفْنَا.

questions.q: Stretch: Say which surah is first, second and last in the mushaf in Arabic.
questions.a: الفَاتِحَةُ السُّورَةُ الأُولَى، البَقَرَةُ السُّورَةُ الثَّانِيَةُ، النَّاسُ السُّورَةُ الأَخِيرَةُ.
B) الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى. Feminine noun, feminine ordinal, after the noun: الحِصَّةُ الأُولَى.

questions.q: What is الخَامِس? A) fifth B) five C) fifteen
Big question: how do we say 'first' and 'second', and when do we need them?
questions.a: الأَوَّل / الأُولَى and الثَّانِي / الثَّانِيَة; for order: lessons, months, year groups.
